Mountain Report

A Little Something to Get Us Started

November 25, 2026

Beginner Area This Weekend

The good news is that we're anticipating getting guests on snow this weekend in the beginner area, with lift service via the Flapjack Conveyor. Unfortunately, we're not going to be able to connect the dots on Upper Bridge Run in time for this weekend.

It might not be the opening weekend we originally had in mind, but getting that first lift turning and welcoming skiers back to the mountain is a milestone worth celebrating. For those looking to make their first turns of the season, introduce someone to skiing, or spend a little time getting their legs back underneath them, we'll have an opportunity to do just that.

The idea to get Flapjack open for the weekend actually came from our operations team. They've been looking for every opportunity to get guests out on snow, and I love seeing that kind of initiative. It's a good reflection of how motivated this crew is to get the season underway.

Lift tickets (Surface Ticket) will be $38, or $28.50 with the College, Military, Local, or Industry discount (available only at the window with ID).

If you're heading up to the North Shore for Thanksgiving, enjoy your time with family and friends, and take advantage of everything this time of year has to offer. Break out that new gear, get outside, and start warming up those skiing legs. There are plenty of great trails nearby to explore, whether that's a hike to check out a frozen waterfall or simply taking in the views of winter arriving along Lake Superior. Be sure to head into Grand Marais for the annual Oh Ole Night Parade and Christmas tree lighting, a wonderful local tradition to kick off the holiday season!

Top to Bottom Skiing

Our team has done everything they can to make as much snow as possible with the limited cold weather we've had. They've even run extension cords from neighboring trails to stack snowguns as tightly as possible along Upper Bridge and River Run, making the most of every available connection we have to work with. It's been a real team effort, and I appreciate how hard everyone has pushed to give us a shot at opening.

I took a ride around the mainside this morning just before sunrise to get a look at what we were able to produce overnight. It was a beautiful morning to be out on the mountain, and the sunrise certainly didn't disappoint.

While we had a really productive night of snowmaking last night, we just haven't had enough consistent cold weather to get the coverage we need in time to open a lift for this weekend. 

While we're not quite where we hoped to be for the weekend, I'm proud of the effort our team has put in and encouraged by the progress we've made. We'll continue to take advantage of every opportunity we get and build on what we've been able to accomplish over the past few days to get more terrain open as soon as possible.

I'm looking forward to getting the season started this weekend and seeing some turns made on the mountain.

-Benjamin Bartz, Chief of Resort Operations

Season Pass Pickup: Beginning November 23, passes can be picked up at Eagle Ridge Registration from 8 AM-5 PM.

Reservation Questions? Call our reservations team at 218-663-7281 for assistance.
